cards.card_text: Animals and birds and reptiles and fish The stars and the moon and the seasons Rivers and mountains and deserts
cards.verse_text: He spoke of trees, from the cedar in Lebanon to the hyssop growing in the wall, and he taught about animals, birds, reptiles, and fish.
cards.snippet: …the hyssop growing in the wall, and he taught about animals, birds, reptiles, and fish.

cards.card_text: All kinds of animals and reptiles and birds Stone tablets with the law written on them Scrolls from the prophets of Israel
cards.verse_text: It contained all kinds of four-footed animals and reptiles of the earth, as well as birds of the air.
cards.snippet: It contained all kinds of four-footed animals and reptiles of the earth, as well as birds of the air.

cards.card_text: Peter looked closely at the sheet and saw four-footed animals, wild beasts, reptiles and birds of the air.
cards.verse_text: I looked at it closely and saw four-footed animals of the earth, wild beasts, reptiles, and birds of the air.
cards.snippet: …at it closely and saw four-footed animals of the earth, wild beasts, reptiles, and birds of the air.

cards.card_text: Trading God's glory for images of birds and reptiles is like handing over my whole bakery for a drawing of a cookie.
cards.verse_text: and exchanged the glory of the immortal God for images of mortal man and birds and animals and reptiles.
cards.snippet: …immortal God for images of mortal man and birds and animals and reptiles.

cards.card_text: Then James runs down the list: animals, birds, reptiles and sea creatures, all being tamed by people.
cards.verse_text: All kinds of animals, birds, reptiles, and creatures of the sea are being tamed and have been tamed by man,
cards.snippet: All kinds of animals, birds, reptiles, and creatures of the sea are being tamed and have been tamed…
